title: ResultSlotOccupied refusal tells a read-only reviewer to report status failed, but its own submission path refuses that packet
outcome: When a reviewer's attempt result slot is already occupied, the recovery guidance in the ResultSlotOccupied refusal names an action the reviewer can actually take. Today it says "report status: failed without findings", but verify_review_input_for_submission (src/delegation_review_input.rs ~646-650) checks the existing envelope and returns the same refusal before the failed-without-findings exemption (~657), so following the instruction loops on refused tool calls. Keep the slot immutable, and direct the child to end its failed turn so the parent can start a fresh attempt.
acceptance: The ResultSlotOccupied refusal no longer instructs the reviewer to submit into the occupied slot. It tells the child to end its turn and the parent to start a fresh attempt, and the result slot stays immutable.
A test drives the occupied-slot case, follows the refusal's own guidance, and shows no further submission is required or refused in a loop.
